_comment: Landmarks built by tools/blender/lm_*.py (see SPEC_LANDMARKS.md). size / bbox / marker pos+rot are in Blender asset space (metres, Z up, front = +Y, rot = XYZ euler degrees; a marker's +Y is its forward). godot_pos = (x, z, -y), godot_yaw = rotation about Godot +Y in degrees (marker forward = -Z rotated by yaw). part_origins = pivots of moving parts. tris includes the hidden `col` part (tris_col).

assets.notes: TORQUE HOUSE mod garage. Footprint 16x14 (x -8..8, y -7..7), walls 0.25, wall/parapet top 6.0, stepped sign false-front above the bay to z 8.1. Interior floor 0.02, ceiling 5.3. Bay opening x -2.5..2.5, z 0..4.02 (4.0 clear) in the +Y wall; part `door` = roll-up door inside the wall thickness, origin at the centre of its TOP edge (0, 6.875, 4.02) - scale Z towards the origin or slide up 4 m (it stays hidden inside the false front). Lift posts at x +-1.87 (3.4 m clear), overhead beam at z 4.2. Office booth in the back +X corner (counter hatch on its +Y side). Extra marker `spawn`. Bollards / tyre stack stand up to 0.75 m in front of the +Y wall.

BULWARK ARMS gun shop. Footprint 12x10 (x -6..6, y -5..5), walls 0.25, interior floor 0.02, ceiling 3.2, roof 3.45, parapet coping 4.0, sign box to 4.15, door canopy + bollards up to 1.1 m in front of the +Y wall. Entrance opening 1.6x2.42 at x -0.8..0.8 in the +Y wall with sliding glass leaves door_l / door_r (origin = bottom centre of each leaf; door_l slides -0.8 X, door_r +0.8 X). Storefront windows have security bars. L-shaped glass counter (long leg along X at y -2.3..-1.65, short leg along Y at x 3.9..4.55), staff zone behind it, long-gun racks on the back wall, pistol board on the +X wall, ammo shelves + armour mannequin on the -X side. Closed RANGE door in the back wall at x -3.5..-2.5 (solid in col). Gunsmith workbench on the -X wall at y -4.6..-2.4; marker `workbench` stands in front of it looking at it (-X). counter/staff face each other across the cash-wrap section of the counter (register on it).

The Hideout beach bungalow. Origin = ground centre of the HOUSE (house x -6..6, y -4.5..4.5); the 6x7 garage is attached on -X (x -12..-6, y -2.5..4.5, front flush with the house front), so garage_spot / garage_out sit at x -8.875 (matches the stand-in's x -9). House on a 0.45 plinth: interior floor z 0.45 (no step at the door: porch deck 0.45, two 0.15 steps down to the ground in front of the porch, col = sloped prism), ceiling 3.2, low hip roof (tint_b) eave 3.55 / ridge 4.8; walls tint_a (recolourable); garage floor 0.02, flat roof 2.97. Part `door` = front door leaf (opening x -1.5..-0.5, z 0.45..2.6), origin on the hinge line (-1.49, 4.295, 0.45): rotate about Z, it swings into the house (negative yaw = toward -Y). Part `garage_door` = roll door (opening x -10.375..-7.375, z 0..2.4), origin at the centre of its TOP edge: scale Z toward the origin (roll-up) - do not slide it (it would poke through the garage roof). `entrance` stands on the porch deck 1.5 m in front of the door (z 0.45). bed / wardrobe / save stand on the floor facing the furniture; save = the desk chair spot.

THREADLINE clothing store. Footprint 12x10 (x -6..6, y -5..5), walls 0.25, floor 0.02, ceiling 3.2, roof 3.45, parapet 4.0. Striped awning over the whole storefront (y 5..6.1, lowest edge z 2.33) + two planters at the door (y 5.4). Entrance 1.6x2.42 at x -0.8..0.8 with door_l / door_r (slide 0.8 along -X / +X). Window displays with the two torso mannequins, garment racks, folded-stack shelves on the -X wall, shoe wall on the +X wall, counter + register in the back +X corner (navy feature wall with a neon sign), two fitting booths with curtains in the back -X corner; marker `wardrobe` stands in front of them facing -Y.

QUIKNOOK 24 convenience store. Footprint 12x10 (x -6..6, y -5..5), walls 0.25, floor 0.02, ceiling 3.2, roof 3.45, parapet 4.0; front canopy to y 6.45 on two posts at x +-5.5 (fascia sign 2.7..3.7), ice chest + bin under it. Entrance 1.6x2.42 at x 1.4..3.0 (door_l slides -X, door_r +X). Three gondolas along Y (x -3.55, -1.35, 0.85) + -X wall shelving = three shelf aisles 1.3 wide, lit drinks coolers along the back wall (x -5.6..1.0), counter along Y at x 3.8..4.4 (staff behind it on the +X side), chips rack at its front end, ATM against the -X wall near the front. Marker `register` = the cash register itself ON the counter top (z 1.05), its +Y looks at the customer (-X); `counter` = customer spot in front of it, `staff` behind it.

FADE FACTORY barber. Footprint 8x8 (x -4..4, y -4..4), walls 0.25, floor 0.02 (checker tiles), ceiling 3.2, roof 3.45, parapet 4.0. Entrance 1.6x2.42 at x 1.0..2.6 in the +Y wall (door_l slides -X, door_r +X). Part `pole` = the striped core of the barber pole outside (x 3.3, y 4.22), origin on its axis at the bottom of the stripes (z 1.35): spin it about local Z; caps, bracket and glass sleeve are in the shell. Two barber chairs facing mirror stations on the -X wall; marker `chair` = seat point of the first chair (seat top z 0.62, looking at the mirror, -X). Reception counter in the back +X corner (counter / staff), waiting bench on the +X wall.

GULL GAS fuel station. Canopy 14x9 (x -7..7, y -4.5..4.5), underside 4.6, top 5.5, on 4 columns at (+-3.5, +-2.6) standing on the two pump islands (islands along Y at x +-3.5, 1.3 wide, y -3.5..3.5, top 0.15). Lanes: central lane x -2.85..2.85 (one car beside each island), outer lanes x +-(4.15..7). Pumps at (+-3.5, +-1.25). Markers pump_1..4 sit at each pump's foot ON THE GROUND (z 0, under the island top) and their +Y points to the central lane: a car refuels with its side ~1.5 m from the marker. pump_1 (-3.5, 1.25), pump_2 (-3.5, -1.25), pump_3 (3.5, 1.25), pump_4 (3.5, -1.25). light_1..4 under the canopy lamps (z 4.35). Price pylon 7 m at the +X/+Y corner (x 8.6, y 5.2). col: columns, islands, pumps, bollards, bins, pylon + canopy slab.

Arched hangar 26 x 32 (x -13..13, y -16..16), vault = circular arc r 13.45 (centre z -3.45), apex 10.0, corrugated cladding tint_a_metal (recolour with tint_a), +Y end open. Front door portal: top track beam at z 7.45..7.85 between two posts at x +-13.15; two door leaves parked at the sides (x +-7.4..+-12.95, static, in the shell). Clear opening between the parked leaves: x -7.4..7.4, height 7.45 (planes up to ~14 m span). Back wall with a row of windows and a closed personnel door. Floor top z 0.02 with a yellow guide line on x = 0. Marker `spot` = aircraft parking point at the centre (0, 0, 0.02), +Y (out of the door). light_1..4 under the high-bay lamps (z 7.55). col: vault as 8 flat segments per side, back wall, floor slab, portal posts, parked leaves, fixtures along the walls.

Airfield control tower, footprint 8x8, height 24.0 (antenna tip). Octagonal concrete shaft 4.4 across (z 0..17.6) with a closed steel door on +Y (no interior), caged ladder on the +X face, window slits; balcony deck at 17.6 with railing; octagonal cab with outward-slanted @Glass (z 18.6..21.2); roof 21.2..21.55 with antennas, led_red obstruction light at the mast tip and a rotating airport beacon. Part `beacon` = the beacon drum (green/white lenses), origin on its axis at (0.9, -0.9, 22.5): spin about Z. col: boxes (shaft, deck, cab, roof, door step) + deck railing. Extra marker `entrance` in front of the door (ground).

Small airfield terminal (not enterable), 18 x 10 x 5: building x -9..9, y -5..3, roof 4.0, sign fascia to 5.0; front curtain wall of @Window panes with closed glass entrance doors; canopy y 3..5 (underside 3.1) on 4 columns at y 4.8; benches, luggage cart, bins, planters and a flight-info board under the canopy. col: building box, canopy slab, columns, benches, cart, bins, planters, info board.

Red/white banded lattice radio tower, base 5x5 tapering to 2x2 at 40 m, total height 42 incl. antennas. Platforms (grating + railing) at z 14, 28 and 40 (top surfaces). Ladder on the +Y face running through hatches. Markers: ladder_bottom (ground, 0.5 m in front of the ladder, looking at it), ladder_top (on the 40 m platform next to the hatch), jump (on the -Y edge of the top platform where the railing has a 1.2 m gap with a short yellow plank sticking out 0.9 m; +Y of the marker points outward/-Y). col: 3 platform boxes + 4 slanted leg boxes (+ top railings, plank).

Water tower, height 20 (finial). Four braced legs (feet at +-3.3) carry a catwalk ring at z 12.4 and a cylindrical tank r 4.2 (z 12.9..17.6) with a conical roof; 'VESPER BAY' wrapped around the +Y side; ladder up the +Y/+X leg and the tank wall; rust streaks. col: 4 slanted leg boxes + octagonal tank cylinder + catwalk.

Lighthouse on a rock base (base dia ~6+rocks, height 22.0 incl. lightning rod). White tapered tower with two red bands, gallery deck at 16.0 with railing, @Glass lantern room (16.25..18.75), red cap. Part `lamp` = rotating lens assembly (emis_always_white lens blocks), origin on the axis at (0, 0, 17.45): spin about Z. Marker `light` at the lens centre (the game puts an OmniLight there). Door on +Y at the base (closed). col: octagonal tower prism, plinth cylinder, gallery deck.

Ship-to-shore container gantry crane, tint_a_metal structure (the game tints it orange). Four box legs at x +-7, y +-11 (rail gauge 22 across Y; crane rails along X at y +-11), portal beams at z 20..22, boom girder z 24..25.6 from y +12 (machinery house end) to y -28 (outreach over the water, -Y), A-frame apex 30.0 with fore/back stays. Trolley + operator cab at y -16, spreader hanging at z 13. Stair flights up the +X/+Y leg. Static (no moving parts). col: 4 leg boxes + leg feet bogies.

Drivable 3-level parking structure 32 x 24 (x -16..16, y -12..12); deck tops z 0.02 (ground deck) / 3.2 / 6.4, slabs 0.3 thick (clear height 2.88 / 2.9). Entrance on +Y: opening x -3.6..4.0 (6.2 m clear lane x -3.6..2.6 + pay booth island x 2.6..3.9). Circulation: front lane y 5.5..11.75, back lane y -11.75..-4.5, two rows of 2.5 m bays in between (stair core occupies the two centre front bays, x -2.5..2.5, y 1..5.5, rising to 9.6 with the neon 'PARKING' sign). Ramp A (level 0 -> 1) in the -X strip x -15.75..-11.25, foot y 6 (z 0.02) up to y -7 (z 3.2), rising toward -Y; ramp B (level 1 -> 2) in the +X strip x 11.25..15.75 from y -7 (z 3.2) up to y 6 (z 6.4), rising toward +Y; both 4.5 wide over 13 m (13.8 deg). Ramp A is a solid wedge, ramp B a sloped slab (lane under it on level 0). Perimeter barriers 1.1 high with a horizontal slot, full walls beside the ramps, barriers round the slab openings. col: slabs, ramp prisms, barriers/walls, columns, stair core, booth. Markers: entrance (outside the entrance on the ground), top (top deck centre, z 6.4).

Plaza fountain dia 8.0: granite step ring (r 4.0), marble basin wall r 3.3..3.7 up to z 0.8, water surface (ice_blue) at z 0.55, eight arcing jets, two-tier centre piece with water curtains (ice_blue) and a spray top (3.3). col: 12 boxes forming the basin ring, basin floor at z 0.45 (you can wade in), centre pedestal.

Abstract sculpture 3 x 3 x 6: granite step + bevelled plinth (2.2 sq, top 1.6) with a bronze plaque on +Y, six twisted stacked triangular prisms in bronze rising to 6.0. col: step, plinth, sculpture box.

Hilltop viewing deck 9 x 6 (x -4.5..4.5, y -3..3), timber deck top z 0.6 on posts reaching down to z -1.4 (sink into slopes), railing on the front (+Y = view direction) and sides, steps down at the back (-Y, x -0.8..0.8) to z 0. Two coin binoculars at the front rail, bench, info board. Marker `view` at the front rail centre (deck height, looking +Y). col: deck box, railing boxes, steps slope, binocular posts, bench, board.

Octagonal park gazebo dia 5: platform top z 0.45 (r 2.5) with two steps on +Y, 8 white posts, railing with balusters (open on +Y), benches inside, teal octagonal roof (eave 3.0, apex 4.5) with a gold finial to 5.0. col: platform prism, step slope, posts, railing segments, roof pyramid.

Marina shack 7 x 5 (x -3.5..3.5, y -2.5..2.5), board-and-batten walls, gable roof (ridge along X, top 4.0), not enterable. Front (+Y, faces the water) with a service hatch + propped flap, closed door, neon 'MARINA' sign (neon_cyan) on the fascia, two life rings, plank deck y 2.5..3.7 (top z 0.2) with mooring bollards, rope coil and a boat fuel pump at the +X end of the deck. col: body box, deck slab, pump, bollards.

Monorail guideway beam segment 8.0 (Y) x 0.9 (X) x 1.2 deep. ORIGIN AT THE CENTRE OF ITS TOP FACE: z = 0 is the running surface, the beam hangs down to z -1.2. Tile along Y every 8.0 m. Steel power rail strip on each side (z -0.36..-0.24), expansion joint plates at both ends. col: one box.

T-pier for the monorail: origin on the ground, footing 2.0 sq (z -0.3..0.25), round shaft r 0.45 to z 4.8, flared head 2.2 (X) x 1.2 (Y) with its top at z 5.8 + two bearing pads; a beam set on it at z 5.8 has its running surface at 7.0. col: footing, shaft box, head box.

Elevated BayLine station, 24 long (y -12..12). Track beam passes at x = 0 (not modelled). Platform x 1.45..6.6, floor z 7.55, yellow tactile strip along the edge (x 1.45..1.95), canopy (z 10.2..10.45) on posts at x 6.2 overhanging the edge, neon 'BAYLINE' signs on both canopy fascias (+X street side, -X track side), benches, ticket machine, railing on the +X edge. Stairs 1.8 wide outside the +X edge (x 6.6..8.4): foot at the +Y end (y 12.1, ground), flight 1 down-to-up toward -Y to a mid landing (z 3.775, y 5.9..4.1), flight 2 to the top landing (z 7.55, y -2.1..-3.9) which opens onto the platform. Markers: entrance (ground at the stair foot), board (platform edge at the train door, x 1.6, y 0, z 7.55, looking -X at the track), wait (platform centre). col: platform slab, supports, stair flights as sloped boxes, landings, railings, canopy posts.

Ferris wheel dia 22, axle at (0, 0, 13). Part `base` = A-frame supports, axle bearings, boarding deck (top z 0.15) and ticket booth. Part `wheel` = rims, inner neon ring, spokes with neon_pink/neon_cyan strips, hub; wheel plane XZ, axle along Y, origin at the axle: spin about its local Y. Parts gondola_01..12 = cabins, siblings of `wheel` (children of the root), origin at each hanging pivot: gondola_k pivot for wheel angle a is axle + 11 * (cos(a + (k-1)*30 deg), 0, sin(a + (k-1)*30 deg)) in asset space (k=1 at +X, counter-clockwise seen from +Y); keep their rotation at identity so they hang upright. gondola_10 (k=10, 270 deg) is at the bottom with its floor at the deck. col: base only (legs, deck, booth).

Half-court basketball 15 x 14 (x -7.5..7.5, y -7..7), slab top z 0.08, court lines (line_white) incl. key, free-throw circle, three-point arc and half-court circle; hoop on a post behind the -Y baseline (rim centre (0, -5.4, 3.05), backboard y -6.0), facing +Y. Marker `hoop` at the rim centre, `shoot` at the free-throw spot (ground, looking at the hoop). col: slab, post, arm + backboard.
